rationale: SQLite and in-process components satisfy the prototype constraints without extra infrastructure.
content:
# Design

Domain has entities and ICodeGenerator; Application owns use cases and repository interfaces; Infrastructure implements SQLite persistence; API composes endpoints and background clicks. Dependency direction points inward.

Base62CodeGenerator.Generate returns seven characters using RandomNumberGenerator.GetInt32, which avoids modulo bias. Domain tests check length, charset, 10,000 samples and entity invariants.

Workflow: requirements -> design -> implement/tests/docs -> validate -> release. Implement, tests and docs run concurrently; their changes land one at a time through real exit gates. Requirements, Design and Release require approval.

Replay writes the pinned Base62 generator, pinned DomainTests and docs/generated/greenfield.md. Remaining product files are prerequisites from Phases 1–2. Validate must run real dotnet build and dotnet test; Release is readiness only, with no deployment.
